question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **Querulous**
solution:
The correct answer is: **2) Complaining**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Querulous"** means complaining in a petulant or whining manner; it is often used to describe someone who is habitually grumbling or fretful. (शिकायती)
 
 
• **Example:** The querulous tone of his voice made it hard to have a constructive conversation.
 
 
• **"Complaining"** is the correct synonym for "Querulous" as it directly relates to expressing dissatisfaction or annoyance about something. (शिकायत करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She was constantly complaining about
